problem: Triangle ABC in the xy-plane has vertices A(2, -3), B(2, 5), and C(8, 1). What is the area of triangle ABC?

bad.why: Desmos (API v1.11) draws polygon() but displays no area for it and has no area() function, so the plan never shows the answer; read the base and height from the coordinates instead.

algebraFirst.description: Applies the shoelace formula to the three vertices, or sketches the triangle and computes (1/2)(8)(6) by hand.

explanationNotes: Explain that A and B share x = 2, so side AB is vertical with length 5 - (-3) = 8 and works as the base; the height is the horizontal distance from C to that side, 8 - 2 = 6. The reference-sheet formula area = (1/2)(base)(height) then gives 24.
notes: Verified: shoelace area 24. Distractors: 48 omits the 1/2, 32 uses 8 as the height, 16 uses 4. In Desmos v1.11.4 \operatorname{polygon}(...) has evaluationDisplayed false, and area()/perimeter() error with 'This calculator does not support the area function'.
